_readme: Bundled rule-of-thumb reference table used by modules/fee_estimation_engine.py's estimate_fee_split() -- the fast, offline default path for the Fee Estimate tab's indicative discipline split. Every entry's 'source' and 'confidence' fields are deliberately honest: these are generic, typical multidisciplinary civil-engineering consulting fee-split PATTERNS (not a live lookup, not a named published survey), meant only as an internal sanity-check starting point per the INDICATIVE_NOTE shown alongside them in the app. Each project type's fee_split percentages sum to 100. 'Default' is the required fallback for any project type not otherwise listed here.
